query:
SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total,
  MIN(saleDate) as primeira_venda,
  MAX(saleDate) as ultima_venda
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
GROUP BY status
